# Stack48 Admin UI

> Presentational React + shadcn/ui kit for Stack48 internal ops dashboards. Consumed as a git dependency (`github:121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit#vX.Y.Z`), not from npm. Visual source of truth: gtm.stack48.com (Inter 13px, zinc canvas, blue-500 brand, 2px radii).

**Rules:** presentational only. Pass data via props. No Supabase, Resend, fetching, or business logic.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/README.md): git install, Tailwind preset, styles.css, AppShell + DataTable quickstart
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install, theme, **full export catalog**, compose folders, house style, token names
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): every component PR ships docs, stories, TSDoc, changeset
- [ADOPTION](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION.md): GTM class / `ui/*` / charts / inbox / SendTestModal → kit mapping
- [components index](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/docs/components/README.md): every component doc
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): semver via changesets; tags are vX.Y.Z GitHub Releases, no registry publish

## Code

- [src/tokens.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/tokens.ts): JS token map
- [src/styles/theme.css](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/styles/theme.css): shadcn CSS variables (`:root` and `.dark`)
- [src/styles/styles.css](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/styles/styles.css): public stylesheet
- [src/preset.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/preset.ts): Tailwind v3 preset
- [src/lib/cn.ts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/blob/main/src/lib/cn.ts): `cn()`
- [src/primitives](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/primitives)
- [src/admin](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/admin)
- [src/charts](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/charts)
- [src/inbox](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/inbox)
- [src/states](https://github.com/121-Online/Stack48-Admin-UIKit/tree/main/src/states)

## Imports (every public subpath)

```
@stack48/admin-ui                 cn, tokens (+ zinc/blue/red/emerald/amber/hsl/lightSemantic/darkSemantic/radii/shadows/typography/spacing/layout/semanticCssVarNames), preset, adminUiContentGlobs, and all namespace re-exports
@stack48/admin-ui/tokens          token objects (same token exports as root)
@stack48/admin-ui/preset          default Tailwind preset + adminUiContentGlobs
@stack48/admin-ui/cn              cn()
@stack48/admin-ui/styles.css      public CSS (fonts + variables + GTM body)
@stack48/admin-ui/theme.css       CSS variables only
@stack48/admin-ui/primitives      Button, buttonVariants, Input, Textarea, Label, labelVariants, Checkbox, Switch, Badge, badgeVariants, StatusIndicator, Section, SectionDivider, Separator, Skeleton, Select (+ Group/Value/Trigger/Content/Label/Item/Separator), Tabs (+ List/Trigger/Content), Dialog (+ Portal/Overlay/Trigger/Close/Content/Header/Footer/Title/Description), DropdownMenu (+ Trigger/Content/Item/CheckboxItem/RadioItem/Label/Separator/Shortcut/Group/Portal/Sub/SubContent/SubTrigger/RadioGroup), Popover (+ Trigger/Content/Anchor), Tooltip (+ Trigger/Content/Provider), Toast (+ Provider/Viewport/Title/Description/Close/Action)
@stack48/admin-ui/admin           AppShell, Sidebar, Breadcrumb, Breadcrumbs, PageHeader, Topbar, DataTable, DataTableToolbar, DataTablePagination, pageWindow, FilterCheckbox, FilterSelect, ChipList, MultiSelectFilter, Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableCell, TableMessage, DataTableRoot/Head/Body/Row/Cell (GTM aliases), isActiveRoute, defaultRenderLink
@stack48/admin-ui/charts          ChartA11y, ChartEmpty, HiddenDataTable, ChartTooltip, chartColors, DailyActivityChart, defaultDailyActivitySeries, DeliveryFunnel, DeliveryFunnelHorizontal, defaultFunnelColors, defaultDateLabel, defaultDateTick, defaultNumberFormat, defaultPercentFormat, KpiDivider, KpiItem, KpiStrip, KpiTile, KpiTileRow, MetricsHeader, BounceRateChart, ComplaintRateChart, defaultBounceThresholds, defaultComplaintThresholds, RateTrendChart, Sparkline, StackedBars, TaperedFunnel, defaultRegionCoordinates, WorldMap
@stack48/admin-ui/inbox           InboxLayout, FolderList, MessageList, ThreadView, MessageMeta, SandboxedHtml, buildInboxHtmlSrcDoc, INBOX_HTML_CSP, useInboxKeyboard, INBOX_SHORTCUTS, isEditableKeyboardTarget, nextFocusedIndex, resolveInboxKey
@stack48/admin-ui/states          EmptyState, LoadingState, Spinner, ErrorState, Banner, InlineAlert, StaleWarning, FormField, FormSection, ConfirmDialog, MultiEmailModal, testQueuedMessage, ScheduleEditor, SendingIdentityEditor, DAY_KEYS, DAY_LABELS, DEFAULT_CONFIRM_TOKEN, DEFAULT_EMAIL_PATTERN, DEFAULT_MAX_EMAILS, DEFAULT_SCHEDULE, EMPTY_SENDING_IDENTITY, HHMM_PATTERN, LOCAL_PART_PATTERN, filterTimezones, isTypeConfirmAccepted, isValidEmail, listTimezones, parseEmailList, previewFromAddress, previewReplyToAddress, timeToMinutes, validateDayWindow, validateFromName, validateLocalPart, validateSchedule, validateSendingIdentity, validateTimezone

```

Untrusted email HTML: `SandboxedHtml` only. Never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

## House style (non-negotiable)

Professional ops tool. Dense. Full-width layouts. No boxy cartoon cards. Data via props. Presentational only.

`--primary` is zinc-900. `--brand` / `--ring` is blue-500 (GTM `--accent`). `--radius` is 0.125rem.
